summary:
growmos is a zero-dependency Python CLI plus a plain-JSONL .growmos/ store that keeps a living, provenance-carrying knowledge graph inside a repository. Built by Codician under the MIT license, it implements the Anthropic knowledge-graph playbook (extraction, resolution, assembly, querying, evaluation loop) as agent-native task packets: the CLI does the deterministic work and the agent the user already runs does the judgment — no API key needed.

It integrates with Claude Code (hooks make it fully hands-off), Codex, Grok, Cursor and Gemini via instruction blocks and an MCP stdio server; git hooks queue changed docs; headless mode covers cron and CI. It ships an interactive explorer (growmos view), grounded querying with edge citations, deterministic fact-checking, an automatic evaluation harness, and exports to Neo4j, Postgres, DOT and Mermaid.

As of 0.1.5 it is published on PyPI, listed on the official MCP Registry as com.codician/growmos, and governed by the zero-dependency, provenance, security and code-of-conduct rules.
